profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, C++, Java, Unity
profile.summary: Senior developer with proficiency in C++, OpenGL, Java, and C#; object-oriented and SQL database design; strong skills in applied mathematics; embedded Android; experience in game and simulation programming; research in computational physics.

positions.title: Lead Software System Engineer
positions.description: Led a small team to develop an augmented reality (AR) model-viewer app in Unity for Magic Leap 2 devices. Managed communication between multiple stakeholders and development teams for the model-viewer app. Mentored junior programmers and summer interns in Unity application development for AR. Developing Android XR applications for new hardware using Unity, Kotlin, and C++ plugins.

positions.title: Staff/Lead Software Engineer, System Applications
positions.description:
- Led a small team to develop an augmented reality (AR) model-viewer app in Unity for Magic Leap 2 devices.
- Managed communication between multiple stakeholders and development teams for the model-viewer app.
- Mentored junior programmers and summer interns in Unity application development for AR.
- Develop Android XR system applications using both Unity and Jetpack Compose.
- Use AI software engineering tools, such as code completion, to improve task efficiency.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Application Framework
positions.description:
- Developed an advanced display-calibration app in Unity, including a custom UI, localization, and native
plugins.
- Development of UX in C++17 for Magic Leap enterprise device setup, user settings, and 3D calibration apps.
- Contributed to numerous mixed-reality software systems in C++: text typesetting, string localization, user
notifications, multi-user interaction, and 3D world-object animation and visualization.
- Architected and wrote an async collision system in C++ for colliding with a mixed-reality world mesh.
- Expanded the resource system for the Magic Leap game engine, including optimization with preloaded
resources.
- Wrote a bitmap animation system in C++ for the Magic Leap game engine for efficient display of 2D
animations.
- Developed bitmap font renderer in OpenGL using signed-distance fields and shader-based antialiasing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed in Java 8 with Spring a distributed file system (DFS), including robust revision-control
features and server interaction to manage game designers’ assets, which persist in both in the cloud and locally.
• Integrated EASTL into core engine systems for consistent, optimal performance across platforms.
• Wrote in C++11 numerous game-engine components to expose high-performance rendering features, including the
virtual camera, frustum rendering, primitive-line drawing, debug text, and transform manipulation.
• Improved existing game-engine event-system for maximal concurrency with minimal locking.
• Developed game-engine interfaces for middle-ware products providing user-interface composition.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed in Java 8 with Spring a distributed file system (DFS) for cloud-based version control. Integrated EASTL in C++ into core engine systems for consistent, optimal performance across platforms. Wrote in C++ numerous game-engine components for high-performance rendering features. Developed C++ game-engine interfaces for middle-ware products providing user-interface composition.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked with engineers across teams to resolve numerous user-experience and client-server bugs in Java and C++
• Developed with JavaFX a prototype for navigating through a complex graph of inter-dependent simulation objects
• Achieved a factor of seven improvement in performance of the StarCCM+ object selector, a key UI component
• Using the Netbeans API's dynamic property-sheet mechanism, architected and developed a framework for improved layout of nodes representing client-server object properties in the StarCCM+ simulation-tree view
• In C++, optimized the asynchronous framework for performing dynamic queries of client-server objects
• Used C++11 and Java to implement a tag-based client-server work-flow to greatly enhance user productivity

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Achieved a factor of seven improvement in performance of the StarCCM+ object selector, a key UI component. Developed a framework for improved layout of nodes representing object properties in the simulation-tree view. In C++, optimized the asynchronous framework for performing dynamic queries of client-server objects. Used C++ and Java to implement a tag-based client-server work-flow to greatly enhance user productivity.

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description:
• Performed research in non-linear equations, chaotic systems, and structural uncertainties in numerical models.
• Mentored undergraduate and graduate computer-science students in software engineering principles and practice.
• Developed a rich tool suite in C++11 & OpenGL to numerically solve and analyze ordinary differential equations.
• Wrote software tools in Java and SQL to support complex systems’ research and large-scale, legacy data storage.
• Architected in Java a module to instill agents in a resource-exchange model with flexible, adaptive behaviors.
• Developed a Java application to calculate network flows on oil pipelines for infrastructure simulation and analysis.

positions.title: Physics Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Debugged, extended, and optimized C++ codes to numerically solve Maxwell’s equations on parallel clusters.
• Developed I/O plugins to read and write scientific data flexibly, leveraging proven XML and HDF technologies.
• Wrote C++ classes to export circuit-simulation solutions into a universal data-exchange format for visualization.
• Designed object-oriented, pattern-driven Java tools to flexibly manage scientific data archived to an SQL database.
• Wrote multi-threaded user-interface (UI) tools with the Java Swing platform for querying and editing SQL data.

positions.title: Scientific Programmer
positions.description: Debugged, extended, and optimized C++ codes to numerically solve Maxwell’s equations on parallel clusters. Developed I/O plugins to read and write scientific data flexibly, leveraging proven XML and HDF technologies. Wrote C++ classes to export circuit-simulation solutions into a universal data-exchange format for visualization. Wrote multi-threaded user-interface (UI) tools with the Java Swing platform for querying and editing SQL data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed physics-based algorithms in C++ for interactive medical simulations designed to train surgeons.
• Maintained and extended existing code to navigate catheters in the human anatomy with high frame rates.
• Parallelized core physics routines for spatial partitioning and high-performance, real-time collision detection.
• Created extensive unit tests to verify correctness and improve performance of physics and graphics components.
• Worked closely with clinical experts and other software developers to manage product risks and improve quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Shipped two titles: Command & Conquer, Red Alert 3 (2008) and Red Alert 3: Uprising (2009)
• Designed and implemented a prototype for path finding in RTS games using group behaviors and dynamics
• Engineered multiplayer UI screens and reworked network components to operate with the new UI architecture
• Led the creation of game demos by managing development, production, and quality assurance relationships
• Designed and presented to the team a novel RTS engine that could potentially scale well to very large maps
• Navigated through a large code base under source control; refined implementations with code reviews
• Used multiple debugging strategies (breakpoints, asserts, and trace statements) to find and fix problems

positions.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
positions.description:
• Conducted program of research and independent study
• Performed snowball-Earth simulations with community climate model
• Implemented image processing and visualization software

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description: Conducted a program of research in planetary atmospheres with three-dimensional climate models. Implemented in Python analysis and visualization software, as well as Beowulf cluster management.

positions.title: Graduate Student Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed numerical models in C and Fortran of the atmospheres of giant planets and brown dwarfs
• Authored research articles in major journals, and presented research to peers at numerous conferences
• Assisted instruction of introductory astronomy, and taught undergraduate labs and recitation sections

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description: Assisted astrophysics research in gamma-ray detectors for spacecraft and gamma-ray burst phenomena.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Performed research of gamma-ray detectors for spacecraft and theory of gamma-ray bursts
• Used C and Matlab for physical modeling, data analysis, and visualization of scientific results
